lane_impact: L4 enemies-ai blocker ④ + L1 world-exploration. This is spawn PROBABILITY, not aggro radius or leash distance — neither of which is in this blob, and I claim nothing about them. But it is the first authored encounter-rate number in the corpus, and the primitive generalises: any <condition> in nodedata, questdata or uidata can be made probabilistic by the same three tags.
quote: 112_Mobile_NodeData.bin:117 `<property>1,3,<xml><wave><enemy><id>1</id><qty>3</qty></enemy><enemy><id>3</id><qty>2</qty></enemy></wave></xml></property>` :118 `<condition><has><id>100</id><qty>50</qty><comp>rand</comp></has></condition>`. StatsManager.as:4222 `if(comparison == "rand") { return Math.random() * id <= val; }` — so id=100, qty=50 is a 50% roll; the default comparison elsewhere is "gte" (StatsManager.as:4171-4177).
text: The condition system carries a probability primitive — <comp>rand</comp> evaluates Math.random()*id <= qty — and the one authored use in the world data is a flat 50% random-encounter roll on an aggro spawn.
